data.description:
## Observed

When sprint orchestrator invokes `/dso:implementation-plan` via the Skill tool for a story (Phase 2 Implementation Planning Gate), the implementation-plan skill completes all 6 steps and emits the correct STATUS line:

```
STATUS:complete TASKS:<ids> STORY:<story-id>
```

However, the sprint orchestrator does not automatically continue after the Skill tool returns. The orchestrator stops and waits for user input instead of parsing the STATUS line and proceeding to Phase 3 (Batch Preparation).

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `/dso:sprint` on an epic with stories that need implementation-plan decomposition
2. Orchestrator enters Phase 2, Implementation Planning Gate
3. Orchestrator invokes `/dso:implementation-plan <story-id>` via Skill tool
4. implementation-plan runs through Steps 1–6, emits `STATUS:complete TASKS:... STORY:...`
5. Orchestrator stops — does not parse STATUS line or continue to Phase 3

## Expected

After Skill tool returns with STATUS:complete, orchestrator should:
1. Log: "Implementation planning complete for story <id> — created tasks: <ids>"
2. Proceed to post-dispatch validation (step e in Phase 2)
3. Continue to Phase 3 without user input

## Actual

Sprint orchestrator stops after seeing STATUS:complete. User must type "continue" to resume.

## Suspected Root Cause

The ORCHESTRATOR_RESUME fence immediately after the Skill invocation in Phase 2 (line ~808 in SKILL.md) may not be strong enough to override the model's learned behavior of treating STATUS:complete as a terminal signal. 

Compounding factor: recent refactoring commits to implementation-plan SKILL.md (b369f95be7, ebb9fd033a, 6426d4dfd6) may have altered the skill's output pattern or added new phrasing that triggers the model to interpret completion as a session-end. Investigate whether the "Stage-Boundary Exit Write" block (added in a recent commit) includes phrasing that signals the model to stop.

## Investigation

- Review commits b369f95be7, ebb9fd033a, 6426d4dfd6 for any new exit directives, STOP signals, or phrasing changes near the Output Protocol
- Compare ORCHESTRATOR_RESUME fence wording in sprint Phase 2 vs Phase 1 Non-Epic Routing (the latter reportedly does NOT exhibit this issue)
- Check whether the POST-RETURN CONTINUATION line after the ORCHESTRATOR_RESUME fence is sufficient — or whether the fence needs a more explicit ``MANDATORY: continue to step c immediately`` directive inline
- Consider adding a "POST-RETURN: parse STATUS and continue" label as a visible output anchor that the LLM sees in-context (not just as skill text)

## Environment

- Plugin version: 1.16.11 (dso-dev channel)
- Skill invocation: Skill tool (dso:implementation-plan) from sprint Phase 2 Implementation Planning Gate
- Context: Post-compaction sprint session
data.title: [sprint->implementation-plan]: STATUS:complete emitted but sprint orchestrator does not resume -> sprint blocks awaiting manual user intervention
